_doc: Per-page a11y baseline — `<rule_id>: <node_count>`. Updates require explicit review (= a passing PR that intentionally raised or lowered a count). axe rules listed here are KNOWN serious/critical issues that pre-existed this baseline; the test enforces 'no new rule' AND 'no count increase' against this snapshot. Lower a count when fixing nodes; remove the entry when fixing the rule entirely. All main-page serious/critical counts reached zero for 0.9.7 on 2026-08-13. Open-surface entries (`<Page> › <state>`, KT-1887) were measured by the principal on 2026-11-22 on a fresh sandbox backend (scripts/e2e-sandbox-backend.sh). `Plugins › add plugin form`: existing debt, color-contrast on .mcp-cat-pill-count and .mcp-origin-badge.mcp-origin-official among others, scrollable-region-focusable on .mcp-registry-grid; the principal opens the fix ticket. `Workflows › quick prompt form`: color-contrast on .kr-agent-switch-name (the agent picker trigger writes its name at 10 px in the agent colour), removed by KT-1936, which replaces that trigger markup.
